_comment: Single source of truth for which validation gates run locally.
and scripts/dev/validation_policy.py (multiagent.py). Changing a gate here
changes every local call site at once; no code edit is needed.
Set TRIPPLANNER_FULL_SUITES=1 to force every gate on for one shell or one run.
A missing or unreadable file fails closed: every gate runs.

pytest.reason: 2082 tests, 20m22s at -n 2, on every merge, promote and branch-lane publish. Paid once on master by suite-health.ps1 instead.

vitest.reason: Runs with pytest at every gate; jsdom setup costs tens of seconds per file. Paid once on master by suite-health.ps1 instead.
